program_selection: all 46 programs in the existing frozen benchmark; no new program selection
mutant_selection: all 1000 benchmark mutants, no difficulty or outcome filtering
input_semantics: primary main-study ordered inputs, frozen before this finite-shot extension; no regeneration or reordering
statistic: maximum X/Y/Z total-variation distance between independent fixed and comparison samples
threshold: per program/method/replicate/test/shots/noise original-vs-original empirical quantile at 1-alpha/10 with numpy method=higher
exact_reference_oracle: max global XYZ TVD >= 0.05 using ideal statevector
aggregation: sampling seeds, suite replicates, and mutants are summarized within program; programs receive equal weight
inference: paired program differences; percentile bootstrap 95% CI with 5000 program resamples; Wilcoxon signed-rank where nonzero pairs permit; Holm over 6 primary/secondary comparisons (2 baselines x AUC/MS1/MS5) separately per environment/shots family
failure_policy: retain every error/timeout; no outcome-based replacement; probability pilot may trigger the predeclared 48-hour feasibility stop
auc: normalized trapezoidal AUC@1-10 for all methods
scope: follow-up on the known retrospective benchmark, not independent confirmation
reuse: preserve existing selected-mutant observations, per-test calibrated thresholds and null draws where available; compute missing mutants/programs using unchanged seed namespaces
calibration_implementation: Exact NumPy multinomial draws in batches of eight, preserving the original PCG64 sequence, 2000 repeats and 0.995 higher quantile; bounded contiguous allocations
simulation_implementation: Exact Aer statevector; optimization level zero; simulator target restricted to used native gate names plus u/cx; same mathematical unitary
